Phil Foden hat-trick leads Man City to dominant European victory

Phil Foden scored a hat-trick as Manchester City defeated AEK Athens 5-1 in a European match. The victory saw City dominate the game, with Foden being the standout performer. The match also noted injuries to Haaland and Semenyo.
